architecture.title: One Propose–Probe–Compose step at k = 1 — who reads what
architecture.caption: The reference run produces evidence of behaviour. Two scoped editors (INV, DOM) read the trajectory, the request and the sources and each write one candidate tree. Each candidate is probed on the same task; the composer keeps only edits whose own probe mitigated their failure and regressed nothing, or answers KEEP_BASE. Reflection writes edit rows and at most one EXPERIENCE.md entry. The judge reads hidden truth only after the step has committed. (Method from the Harness² paper and repository; the course's loop is common/h2kit.py, a teaching model.)

sequence.title: F1-01, k = 1, seed 0 — the step Lab 02-2 prints
sequence.caption: Captured from Lab 02-2 (SIM, sim-cloud, seed 0). The reference never calls cmms.work_orders and sums kW/ton by hand. The INV editor adds one tool-guidance line (it missed the hand arithmetic); the DOM editor adds the chiller_fault_review skill. Both probes call cmms.work_orders; the composer keeps both edits; always-on grows 245 → 288 tokens.
